about: Real pocket recording, 8.3 min (phone in a trouser pocket, Android Chrome, ~59 Hz): 25 sets with rests. 975 skips: 928 landing spikes (6-8 g, unambiguous) plus 47 soft landings mid-set (a small bump exactly one beat between two spikes, the rhythm unbroken). Uncertain by a few: set starts/ends with shuffling and one 1.2 s stumble. Phone model and start time removed.
